rows.name: Virginia Health Information Technology Advisory Commission
rows.mandate: Advises the Governor on health information technology policy, interoperability standards, and digital health infrastructure across Virginia's healthcare ecosystem. Oversees statewide health data exchange and IT modernization strategy.

rows.name: Virginia Board for People with Disabilities
rows.mandate: Advises state government on policies, programs, and services for Virginians with disabilities. Oversees federal Developmental Disabilities Act requirements and advocates for disability rights, accessibility, and inclusion.

rows.name: Virginia Opioid Abatement Authority
rows.mandate: Administers Virginia's opioid settlement funds. Sets funding priorities, reviews grant applications, and oversees evidence-based programs for substance use disorder prevention, treatment, and recovery statewide.

rows.name: Virginia Board of Education
rows.mandate: Sets K-12 education policy for 1.2 million Virginia public school students. Establishes academic standards, graduation requirements, accountability frameworks, and guides education technology modernization.

rows.name: Virginia Early Childhood Advisory Council
rows.mandate: Coordinates Virginia's early childhood education and care system. Oversees federal CCDF compliance, advises on PreK policy, and guides data infrastructure for child care quality improvement.

rows.name: Commission on African Americans
rows.mandate: Advises the Governor and General Assembly on issues affecting African American Virginians. Conducts research, makes policy recommendations, and monitors state programs for equity and inclusion.

rows.name: Virginia Housing Advisory Board
rows.mandate: Advises Virginia Housing on affordable housing finance programs, federal HOME and CDBG fund allocation, and statewide housing data strategy.

rows.name: Governor's Commission on Veteran Services
rows.mandate: Advises on programs and services for Virginia's 750,000+ veterans. Coordinates across state agencies and federal VA programs to improve veteran access to healthcare, housing, employment, and benefits.

rows.name: Virginia Criminal Justice Services Advisory Committee
rows.mandate: Advises the Department of Criminal Justice Services on grant programs, data governance, and evidence-based policy for law enforcement, courts, and corrections across Virginia.

rows.name: Virginia Health Workforce Development Authority
rows.mandate: Develops and oversees Virginia's healthcare workforce pipeline. Manages loan forgiveness programs, advises on training policy, and coordinates with federal HRSA workforce initiatives.

rows.name: Statewide Independent Living Council of Virginia
rows.mandate: Oversees Virginia's Independent Living program under the federal Rehabilitation Act. Sets priorities for the State Plan for Independent Living and advocates for community integration of Virginians with disabilities.

rows.name: Virginia Commission on Intergovernmental Cooperation
rows.mandate: Represents Virginia in multistate and federal-state cooperative policy forums. Advises on intergovernmental fiscal relations, federal legislative impacts, and cross-jurisdictional program coordination.
